description: Election Commission - Notice declaring S. Balaganeshan as a Member of the Town & Gravest PS
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Town & Gravets Pradeshiya Sabha) due to termination of party membership, which falls under electoral processes. It involves the declaration of a new member following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it clearly related to election matters rather than government personnel changes, land, legal, commercial, or other categories.
